origin: Redacted model-visible regression extracted from immutable development trace; branch links reconnected after removing non-tool entries

findings.claim: core.py:encode's as_list default changed from False to True. The only indexed caller, serializer.serialize (serializer.py:3), calls encode(value) with no argument and uses the result as a dict key: {encode(value): value}. With the new default, encode returns [str(value)], which is unhashable, so serialize now raises TypeError for any input.
findings.impact: Every call to serialize(value) that does not pass as_list explicitly now crashes at runtime with TypeError: unhashable type 'list'.
findings.title: encode() default as_list=True breaks serializer.serialize with unhashable list dict key
